title: 10,211 Meters Proves Everest Is Not Always Highest
hook: At 10,211 meters, another mountain can beat Everest.
closing: Records depend on where measurement begins, so the starting line can decide the winner.
question: Which definition of highest wins?

segments.say: Everest reaches 8,849 meters above sea level. That starting line gives it the familiar record.
Mauna Kea measures 10,211 meters from its base. Most of its height stays hidden underwater.
Chimborazo extends 13.4 kilometers beyond a round Earth. The planet's bulge changes which summit reaches farthest.
